description: The Building Green Global Dataset is a dataset listed in energydata.info, an open data portal for energy in developing countries under the section "Energy efficiency", published or maintained by World Bank Group. The Building Green global dataset collects data on building energy codes and standards applicable to new and existing buildings, as well as their enforcement mechanisms and levels of compliance. The dataset is produced by the Global Indicators Group (DECIG), sponsored by the Knowledge for Change Program Trust Fund. Coverage: Sub-Saharan Africa, East Asia and the Pacific, Europe and Central Asia, Latin America and the Caribbean, the Middle East and North Africa, South Asia. It has 2 files in PDF, XLSX. The portal files it under Energy efficiency. The portal gives 2024 as the release date. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC0-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support power-system and electrification planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-energydata-info-world-bank.
